This competition like every other WCA competition is open for all, including 1st timers as long as they know how to solve the listed events and abide by the [WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) Please check the [events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SundownerPune2024#competition-events) tab and the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SundownerPune2024#competition-schedule) tab before registering. All Competitors are expected to help out and volunteer when they can, and although they do not need to arrive at the venue until their first event, coming earlier to help out and run the competition smoothly would be greatly appreciated! Check out all the TABS for more information.
